stem: A wall sensor reports acceptable humidity while three interior-canopy sensors remain high after lights-off. What is the strongest first interpretation?
choices: The wall sensor automatically overrides canopy measurements.
A crop-zone spatial gradient may exist and measurement validity/placement should be verified before changing controls.
All four sensors should be averaged and the pattern ignored.
Humidity does not matter after lights-off.
rationale: Multiple crop-zone sensors showing a persistent different condition support investigating a real spatial gradient while still verifying instruments.
